description: Generated by scripts/generate_fixtures.py: training naming declarations, validation set documents and pass records (docs/training.md). The expected results are hand-written in cases.json.

lr.description: Learning rate of the optimizer (or of one parameter group).

grad_norm.description: Norm of the gradients before clipping.

gpu_util_pct.description: GPU compute utilization sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_util_pct.description: GPU memory-controller utilization sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_used_gb.description: GPU memory in use, sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_total_gb.description: Total GPU memory, sampled by euler-train.

lr.description: Learning rate of the optimizer (or of one parameter group).

grad_norm.description: Norm of the gradients before clipping.

gpu_util_pct.description: GPU compute utilization sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_util_pct.description: GPU memory-controller utilization sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_used_gb.description: GPU memory in use, sampled by euler-train.

gpu_mem_total_gb.description: Total GPU memory, sampled by euler-train.

reference.gt.label: GT
reference.gt.description: The ground truth the prediction is scored against.

depth.alignment.mode.label: depth alignment mode
depth.alignment.mode.description: Configured alignment mode (none, auto_affine, affine); whether a fit ran is depth.alignment.applied.

depth.alignment.fit.label: depth alignment fit
depth.alignment.fit.description: The fitted model (e.g. scale, scale_shift, scale_shift_inverse).

depth.alignment.fit_trim.label: depth alignment trim
depth.alignment.fit_trim.description: Fraction of largest residuals excluded from the fit.

depth.cap.max_m.label: depth cap
depth.cap.max_m.description: Predictions (and filled predicted sky) are clipped at this depth; inert when nothing was clipped.

depth.benchmark.range_m.label: benchmark depth range
depth.benchmark.range_m.description: [min, max] GT depth of the benchmark bins; compared through the stratification it defines.

depth.invalid.policy.label: invalid-value policy
depth.invalid.policy.description: How declared invalid sentinels are treated: exclude_sentinel (not scored) or score_sentinel.

depth.conversion.label: depth conversion
depth.conversion.description: Conversion applied before scoring (none, radial_to_planar, planar_to_radial).

sky.gt.masking.label: GT sky masking
sky.gt.masking.description: Pixels labelled sky in the GT segmentation are left out of every metric (--mask-sky).

sky.pred.masking.label: predicted-sky masking
sky.pred.masking.description: Pixels in the prediction's own sky mask are left out of every metric (--mask-sky-prediction).

sky.pred.fill.label: predicted-sky fill
sky.pred.fill.description: Whether the prediction's sky mask was loaded and used (filled at the depth cap, or excluded under predicted-sky masking).

spatial.policy.label: spatial alignment policy
spatial.policy.description: The configured policy that chose the spatial method (e.g. auto, crop, resize, source_grid).

spatial.resize_target.label: resize target
spatial.resize_target.description: Which grid is resampled when resolutions differ and the prediction is not a crop: gt_grid (prediction onto GT) or prediction_grid (GT onto prediction).

spatial.mask_resample.label: mask resampling
spatial.mask_resample.description: Interpolation used to resample masks (nearest, nearest_exact).

depth.gt.valid_range_m.label: GT validity range
depth.gt.valid_range_m.hint: score both with the same GT validity range, or none
depth.gt.valid_range_m.description: [min, max] GT depth in metres outside which pixels are not scored (either bound may be null). An in-training validation that bounds GT validity records it; evaluations without such bounds record null, the default.

depth.extra_mask.label: extra validity mask
depth.extra_mask.hint: score without the extra mask to compare with an evaluation
depth.extra_mask.description: true when the producer removed pixels with an additional validity mask of its own (for example a training-time mask) whose content is not recorded. Evaluations without one record false, the default.

depth.alignment.applied.label: depth alignment applied
depth.alignment.applied.hint: compare the native space, or two fitted runs
depth.alignment.applied.description: Whether a scale/shift fit to the GT produced the metric space.

depth.input_space.label: input depth space
depth.input_space.description: Detected space of the prediction (metric, relative, affine).

spatial.method.label: spatial alignment
spatial.method.description: How prediction and GT resolutions were reconciled (none, crop, vae_crop, resize_prediction, resize, warp_prediction, warp, pointcloud_projection). Compared through the keys it is derived from.

domain.region.label: domain
domain.region.description: The region of the source frame that was scored, as {frame, box: [top, left, height, width]} in source pixels.

prediction.resample.label: prediction resampled
prediction.resample.description: Factor [height, width] by which the prediction was resampled onto the evaluated grid (target / source); [1, 1] when it was not.

depth.cap.clipped.label: clipped by depth cap
depth.cap.clipped.description: Fraction of scored pixels whose prediction the depth cap changed.

image_mean.label: image mean
image_mean.description: Arithmetic mean of the per-image values.

pixel_pool.label: pixel pool
pixel_pool.description: Every valid pixel of every image pooled into one population; recomputed from per-image values with the metric's pool form and weight.

absrel.description: Mean absolute relative error |d - d*| / d* over valid pixels.

rmse.description: Root mean squared error in meters.

delta1.description: Fraction of pixels with max(d/d*, d*/d) < 1.25.

count.description: Valid pixels scored per image; the weight of pooled standard metrics.
